fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Detached Structure; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Open Terrain; Storage Area; Equipment Storage Area; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Multiple Structures; Single Access Point; Open Terrain; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install reflective address markers at the driveway entrance visible from both directions of approach.
• Mark the single access drive entrance clearly so responding units can identify it without slowing to search.
• Post a site map near the driveway entrance showing the locations of all structures, the parking area, and the storage areas.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles and stored equipment so responding units can reach all structures without repositioning.
• Identify and mark a designated staging area within the vehicle parking area for responding units that does not block the access drive.
• Establish a secondary foot path around the perimeter to allow responders to reach the rear of the property when vehicle access is not possible.
• Mark any gates in the perimeter fencing with reflective indicators and keep them unlocked or secured with a Knox-type lock for emergency access.
• Keep stored equipment and materials in the equipment storage area consolidated so they do not spread into the access drive or open terrain around the structures.
• Number or label each detached structure visibly from the access drive so responders can identify and communicate structure locations without confusion.
• Clear a walking path between all structures wide enough for responders carrying equipment.

wildfire.conditions: Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Grass Cover; Woody Debris; Multiple Access Routes; Limited Vegetation Separation; Scattered Trees; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris scattered across the open terrain near structures.
• Thin scattered trees close to the house to increase open space between tree canopy and the structure.
• Cut and remove grass growing directly against the house and any outbuildings.
• Trim shrubs so there is open ground between each shrub and the nearest structure.
• Clear shrubs and tall grass along driveway edges to keep both access routes open and passable.
• Remove dead or dry grass from areas where shrubs and grass cover overlap near the house.
• Separate shrub clusters from one another where they grow in continuous patches near the structure.
• Keep the ground under scattered trees clear of dead grass, fallen branches, and debris.
• Cut grass short in open areas immediately surrounding the house.
• Remove any woody debris piles that have accumulated near the house or outbuildings.
